 4-star guard Chase Branham signs with Indiana: 'He's a dynamic playmaker'
 Alec Lasley @ allasley 11/11/26 1 Share Share 
 2027 four-star combo guard Chase Branham has officially signed with Indiana on the first day of the early signing period.
 Branham, who committed to Indiana in September of 2025, is ranked No. 38 in the Rivals rankings, and No. 29 in the Rivals Industry Rankings. 
 The 6-foot-4 guard transferred to La Lumiere in La Porte, Indiana — previously at Logan-Rogersville (Mo.) ahead of his senior season. 
 Branham is a legit combo guard who can play on and off the ball. He’s shown the ability to score with the ball in his hands, creating off of the dribble, or using terrific off-ball movement to find open scoring opportunities.
 He averaged 21.5 points, 3.6 rebounds and 3.1 assists while shooting 62 percent from the field and 41 percent from three this year, en route to a state championship. 
 As a sophomore he averaged 19.2 points while shooting 61.9 percent from the floor. He averaged 17.9 points as a freshman.
 “Chase is a dynamic playmaker that is effective at all three levels,” Indiana head coach Darian DeVries said. “Because of his work ethic and love for the game, he continues to push himself to new levels and has developed multi-dimensional skills. As good of a player that Chase is, he is an even better person and exemplifies all the attributes that we want our program to be about. It is exciting that Chase is officially a Hoosier and we cannot wait for him to get to Bloomington.”
 Branham is part of a three-man 2027 class for Indiana that includes top-20 center Darius Wabbington and German center Felix Kiehlneker. 
 Wabbington will be signing on Wednesday but have a ceremony on Monday, he tells TheHoosier . Kiehlneker is expected to sign during the early signing period as well.
